label: v6_s5_ve_s0_ep360_r2_a1random_a2rl_es0_probeq
note: no LSTM/recurrence involved -- q1_vec(t) regressed directly onto position(t), same (episode,t) pairs, to test whether h1->self R^2 requires temporal integration or is already achievable from a single timestep's Q vector alone
config_content:
# v6 S5 (docs/v6_instructions.md Sec.3.0 "S5: VE'による推定", design in
# docs/v6_experiment_log.md Sec.37-38). Identical in spirit to
# config/exp/v5_r4_move.yml (v5's VE stage: pretrain from base_l1, SM/
# encoder/decoder/FPM/critic all frozen, only the new estimator module
# trains, data=r2_a1random_a2rl so A-2 is actually moving and has
# reward-revealing behavior to observe) except:
#   model.name  : SuperpositionNetworkProbeQValueEstimation -> SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6ValueEstimation
#   train.pretrain.exp_config : v5_base_l1 -> v6_s3_base_l1
# VE' (model/model.py SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6ValueEstimation) outputs
# r_hat (4-dim, tanh) from ov_enc, then feeds r_hat back through the SAME
# frozen, reward-conditioned probe_critic (using SELF vision, per
# docs/v6_experiment_log.md Sec.37.2) to get Q_hat2 -- NOT an 8-dim
# Q_hat2 directly like v4/v5's VE. No supervision on r_hat anywhere;
# training signal is vision reconstruction loss only.
model:
    name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQV6ValueEstimation
    config: default
    mode: ~
runner: PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
    name: r2_a1random_a2rl
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
    loss_function: l1_loss
    pretrain:
        exp_config: v6_s3_base_l1
        seed: 0
        epoch: 200
    batch_size: 10
    max_epochs: 400
    save_interval: 10
    test_interval: 10
    optimizer: AdamW
    optim_config:
        default:
            lr: 0.001
            weight_decay: 0.01
        freeze:
            - vision_encoder_module
            - vision_decoder_module
            - integration_module
            - feature_prediction_module
            - share_lns
            - probe_critic
            - superposition_module
        per_params:
            - name: bias
              args:
                  weight_decay: 0.0
